propositions: A unit test for missing epic field stubs the Jira field endpoint to permanently omit Epic Link, causing the readiness poll to exhaust the full 120-second production budget instead of failing fast
The test currently sleeps for ~120 seconds wall-clock time to learn something the stub decided up front, burning the entire FIELD_READY_BUDGET_S constant
The readiness code already supports environment-variable override via JIRA_DC_FIELD_READY_TIMEOUT, which _field_ready_timeout() reads before falling back to the module constant
Setting the field readiness budget to zero via monkeypatch.setenv deterministically forces exactly one poll attempt (the required observation), then breaks before any sleep occurs
Adding an assertion on the poll count from _stub_request records proves the test runs the expiry path without reaching sleep, making the guard deterministic rather than timing-dependent
